spans.s: फिञ् tad. affix आयनि applied to the word मिमत in the sense of offspring e.g. मैमतायनिः ; cf.

: it is also added in the same sense of (off- spring) to the words तिक and others as also to the word कौसल्य, two- syllabled words ending with अण् and to words वाकिन and others; e.g. तैकायनिः, कौसल्यायनिः, वाकिनकायनिः etc.; cf.
